up: List all approved drugs (molecules with max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action (action_type in the drug_mechanism table) is exactly 'MODULATOR'. For each such drug, provide the following columns: drug name (pref_name from molecule_dictionary), drug ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), canonical SMILES from compound_structures (if available), mechanism of action description (mechanism_of_action from drug_mechanism), target name (pref_name from target_dictionary), and target ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from target_dictionary). Keep one row per drug-target-mechanism combination. Do not apply any additional filters beyond those stated.
sql: SELECT md.pref_name AS drug_name, md.chembl_id AS drug_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, dm.mechanism_of_action AS mechanism_of_action, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_mechanism dm ON md.molregno = dm.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND dm.action_type = 'MODULATOR';
